alerts.name: PULBASE staging - health (1 DOWN, 2 RECOVERED, 3 NO DATA, 4 REVOKE, 5 RETRIES)
alerts.description: Staging only. 1 DOWN: 2 failed probes; 2 service RECOVERED: 3 healthy probes, 30 min; 3 no health heartbeat for 20 min; 4 at least 1 incomplete session revocation in 20 min; 5 at least 10 RPC retries in 20 min. Priority 3 > 1 > 4 > 5 > 2. Counts are sampled estimates. No alert is not recovery proof. Follow session-revocation-operations.md. Every 5 min, repeat 15 min. Cost/usage alerts unchanged.
alerts.query: SELECT CASE WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'v1', 1, 0)) = 0 THEN 3 WHEN argMax(double1, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) >= 1 THEN 1 WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'revocation-v1' OR blob3 = 'idle-revocation-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 1 THEN 4 WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'revocation-v1', double4 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 10 THEN 5 WHEN argMax(double6, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) > 0 AND argMax(double4, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) - argMax(double6, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) < 1800 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM events.analyticsEngine.pulbase_service_health WHERE accountTag = '60e5472a284dc71bbafbbfac8aa2a940' AND blob1 = 'staging' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '20' MINUTE
